title: Pure Spider

allow.Kumongous, the Sticky String Kaiju: Insect Kaiju the page recommends: Resonance Insect searches it, and it removes a monster by tributing it from the opponent's field.

summary: The 2023 Spider engine with generic Insect support and going-second staples. Mother Spider Splitter and Baby Spider turn a single card on an empty field into a Rank 10, 11, and 12 DARK Insect Xyz climb.

summary.title: Starters
points: Mother Spider Splitter Special Summons itself from the hand while you control no monsters, then tributes itself to Special Summon up to 3 Baby Spiders from the hand or Deck as Level 5 monsters that can only be used for DARK Xyz Summons.
Resonance Insect searches Level 5 or higher Insect monsters (Mother Spider Splitter or Kumongous, the Sticky String Kaiju) whenever it is sent from the field to the GY.
Small World bridges any Insect in your hand into Mother Spider Splitter or Kumongous.

summary.title: Opening: Mother Spider Splitter
steps: Special Summon Mother Spider Splitter onto an empty field and tribute it to summon 3 Level 5 Baby Spiders from the Deck.
Tribute 1 Baby Spider with its own effect to increase the Levels of the other two Baby Spiders by 5, making both Level 10.
Overlay the two Level 10 Baby Spiders into Rank 10 Number 35: Ravenous Tarantula, then rank up into Rank 11 Number 84: Pain Gainer and Rank 12 Number 77: The Seven Sins.

summary.title: Baby Spider GY Recursion
summary.text: By paying half your LP and banishing itself from the GY, Baby Spider detaches 1 material from your DARK Xyz Monster to revive a DARK monster from your GY, such as a fallen Number 35: Ravenous Tarantula. Halving your LP also widens the LP gap between both players, immediately boosting Tarantula's team-wide ATK/DEF buff.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Number 35: Ravenous Tarantula gives all monsters you control ATK and DEF equal to the difference between both players' LP, burns the opponent for 600 whenever they Special Summon, and detaches 1 material to destroy all face-up opposing monsters with ATK less than or equal to its own.

Number 84: Pain Gainer stacks on top of Rank 10 Tarantula, gains DEF equal to the combined Ranks of your Xyz Monsters x 200, burns for 600 on opposing Spell/Trap activations, and detaches 1 material to destroy all opposing monsters with DEF less than or equal to its own.

Number 77: The Seven Sins stacks on top of Pain Gainer or Tarantula with 4000 ATK, detaches 2 materials to banish all Special Summoned monsters your opponent controls and attach 1 of them as material, and detaches 1 material to prevent its own destruction.
Kumongous, the Sticky String Kaiju tributes a problematic opposing boss before you start your OTK.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The 2009 Defense-Position Spider monsters are obsolete and omitted, as is the external Beetrooper Link engine so the list stays focused on the Spider Rank 10-12 OTK core.

main: Starter: summons itself on an empty field and tributes itself to summon three Baby Spiders.
Tributes a DARK monster to raise the Spiders' Levels; revives a DARK monster from the GY.
Generic Insect: searches Mother Spider Splitter or Kumongous when it leaves the field.
Allowed: tributes one of their monsters to clear the way.
Generic search that bridges an Insect in hand to Mother Spider Splitter.
extra: Rank 10 from two Baby Spiders: pumps by the LP difference and wipes weaker monsters.
Rank 11 on Tarantula: wipes monsters with lower DEF.
Rank 12 on a Rank 10 or 11: banishes their Special Summoned monsters.
